title: Emerald-Cut Blue Sapphire Diamond-Halo Cocktail Ring
specifics: A vivid royal-blue emerald-cut sapphire (est. ~4–6 ct) in a full round-diamond halo on a diamond split-shank. The hero cocktail/right-hand ring — also works as a statement engagement ring.
note: Carat + heat/cert drive this most. Estimate assumes a heated Ceylon stone; an UNHEATED stone with a GRS/GIA report can push comfortable retail to $10k+.
heat: Biggest driver here — a fine UNHEATED Ceylon blue with a GRS/GIA/SSEF report commands a large premium over heated.

title: Pink & Blue Sapphire Diamond-Halo Studs + Pear Drop Earrings
specifics: A board of everyday best-sellers: cushion pink-sapphire diamond-halo studs, round blue-sapphire halo studs, and dainty rose-gold pear blue-sapphire diamond drop earrings. Classic, giftable, fast-moving.
note: Per pair. Halo studs ~$600–1,300; pear drop earrings ~$700–1,400, depending on carat and gold weight.
heat: Modest premium; small halo/drop stones are rarely individually certified, so unheated mainly matters if papers come with them.

title: Blue Sapphire Chandelier Drop Earrings
specifics: Open-teardrop chandelier earrings set with graduated round blue sapphires and pavé diamonds (tagged 18k white gold). A bridal / event statement pair with real presence.
note: Depends heavily on total sapphire + diamond carat weight; confirm both.
heat: Premium applies to the sapphires, but melee is seldom certified unheated — realistic only if a report accompanies the pair.

title: Rainbow Fancy-Sapphire Tennis Bracelet
specifics: A full-spectrum line bracelet of round fancy sapphires (blue, teal, green, yellow, orange, pink, purple) — tagged 18k white gold. A social-media magnet and one of the most reliably sellable 'wow' pieces here.
note: Value scales with total carat weight (often 8–12 ct+). Confirm cttw and gold weight.
heat: Multi-color fancy melee — heat status is commercially minor here and rarely certified; treat the premium as small.

title: Rainbow Invisible-Set Princess Sapphire Bracelet
specifics: A wide statement bracelet: channel/invisible-set princess-cut rainbow sapphires bordered by pavé diamonds. Denser and more couture than a standard tennis line — a true showpiece.
note: Higher end due to princess-cut calibrated sapphires + diamond borders; confirm cttw.
heat: Fancy melee — heat status commercially minor; small premium only.

title: Rainbow Sapphire Heart Station Necklace
specifics: A V-layout necklace of heart-shaped fancy sapphires graduating in color, finishing in a pink-sapphire heart drop. Romantic, distinctive, and photographs beautifully.
note: Heart-cut fancy sapphires are labor-intensive; confirm total carat and drop count.
heat: Fancy melee — heat status commercially minor; small premium only.

title: Sri Lanka Map Pendant
specifics: The outline of Sri Lanka traced in pavé diamonds with a single blue sapphire set at the island's south. A one-of-a-kind souvenir/story piece — instant appeal for the 'sourced in Ceylon' narrative.
note: Modest diamond/sapphire content; value is mostly design + gold weight. A signature branding piece.
heat: One small accent sapphire — heat is immaterial; value is the design + gold.

title: Scatter 'Confetti' Multi-Sapphire Teardrop Pendant
specifics: An open teardrop of pavé diamonds with scattered multi-color round sapphires drifting down one side. Modern, artistic, and unlike anything in a typical U.S. case.
note: Confirm sapphire + diamond carat; two-tone gold adds appeal.
heat: Fancy melee — heat status commercially minor; small premium only.

title: Vivid Pink Sapphire Marquise-Halo Sunburst Pendant
specifics: A saturated pink oval sapphire (est. ~2–3 ct) framed by a marquise + round diamond sunburst halo. Pink sapphire is trending hard in the U.S.; this reads far more expensive than its likely cost.
note: Pink hue quality and carat drive value; confirm stone weight.
heat: Pink-sapphire unheated premium is real but smaller than blue.

title: Cat's-Eye Moonstone + Blue Sapphire Halo Bracelet
specifics: A line bracelet of oval blue-sheen (cat's-eye) moonstone cabochons each framed by blue sapphires, with a sea-turtle center motif. A distinctive Ceylon-specialty combination you won't find in U.S. mall stores.
note: Moonstone quality (blue sheen strength) + sapphire count drive value; confirm metal (silver vs gold).
heat: Not applicable — moonstone is never heat-treated; the sapphire accents are minor, so there is no unheated premium.

title: Lavender Star Sapphire Diamond-Halo Rings
specifics: A pair of estate-style cocktail rings centering lavender-to-grey star-sapphire cabochons (asterism) in baguette/marquise diamond ballerina halos. Collector appeal and a rare color.
note: Per ring. Star sharpness, body color and carat drive value; a clean centered star + lab note lifts it.
heat: For STAR sapphire the value axis is 'no diffusion/lattice treatment' + a sharp natural star (AGL/GIA note) more than heat; that is what lifts it.

title: Moonstone + Blue Sapphire Pavé Statement Pendant
specifics: A large glowing moonstone cabochon framed by a wide oval field of pavé blue sapphires. A bold Ceylon-specialty statement pendant that ties moonstone and sapphire together.
note: Confirm moonstone size/quality and sapphire count/metal.
heat: Not applicable — moonstone is untreated; the sapphire pavé is minor.

title: Yellow Sapphire & Diamond Fringe Necklace
specifics: A delicate 'drippy' fringe/station necklace with yellow sapphires and diamond accents. Yellow sapphire + the fringe style are both on-trend; elegant and wearable daily.
note: Confirm total sapphire + diamond carat and gold weight (fringe styles use more gold).
heat: Yellow-sapphire unheated premium is modest; watch for beryllium/diffusion treatment (must be disclosed) — that is a bigger negative than heat.

title: Pear Blue Sapphire & Diamond Laurel Drape Bracelet
specifics: A pear-shaped blue sapphire with cascading marquise-diamond laurel fronds forming a soft drape along the wrist. Elegant, couture-feeling, and unusual.
note: Diamond content is significant; confirm total diamond carat + sapphire size.
heat: Premium applies to the pear-sapphire center; heavy diamond content dilutes the overall % impact.

title: Pink Sapphire Art-Deco Filigree Pendant & Stud Set
specifics: A vintage-revival set: a pear pink sapphire in a black-onyx / mother-of-pearl rose-gold filigree tablet pendant, with matching pink-sapphire diamond-halo studs. Distinctive Art-Deco look.
note: Priced as a set; confirm whether sold together and the sapphire carats.
heat: Pink-sapphire unheated premium is real but smaller than blue.
